articles.title: Mastercard launches stablecoin risk screening for banks and payment providers
articles.snippet: The new service combines payment data and blockchain analytics to help banks detect suspicious stablecoin transactions before settlement.

articles.title: Mastercard Opens Up AI Agent Payments With Early Access and Live Demo
articles.snippet: At Cloudflare Connect, the company demoed an AI agent running a sample ad campaign across nine payments to two merchants on a single approved budget.

articles.title: Mastercard Brings Its Fraud-Fighting Tools to Stablecoin Payments
articles.snippet: Unveiled at Money20/20, the API-based tool combines payment and blockchain intelligence to flag fraud, scams and sanctions exposure before funds move on-chain.
